Your weekly roundup of AI events, hackathons, and meetups at the AWS Builder Loft in San Francisco. Here's what's on deck.

latest.title: Build a secure, multi-tenant MCP server on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
latest.description: A reusable pattern for exposing your data to any AI client (Claude, ChatGPT, Kiro, or your own agent) as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, with strict per-tenant isolation enforced below the model. Uses Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, a JWT authorizer, a request interceptor, and a tool Lambda, so one customer can never read another's data, even if they ask. Includes the build pattern and a validated walkthrough.

latest.title: LifeGuard AI: An Integrated Multi-Agent Framework for Longitudinal Health Record Management and Explainable Risk Assessment in Dependent Care
latest.description: LifeGuard AI, an integrated framework combining two complementary subsystems: Mediforever, a longitudinal digital health record platform providing a lifelong, unified medical data layer; and AHRA (Agentic Health Risk Assessment), a multiagent orchestration system that analyzes physiological inputs, produces explainable risk scores, and safely coordinates real-world escalation workflows with explicit user consent.

latest.title: Building DevTrack: Manage Projects, Build Your Portfolio with Kiro
latest.description:
As developers, we spend countless hours building projects, completing tasks, solving problems, and learning new technologies. Yet when it comes time to showcase our work, many of us struggle to maintain a portfolio that truly reflects our experience.

This challenge inspired the creation of DevTrack — a platform designed to help developers manage their projects while automatically building a professional portfolio from their work.

latest.title: Building Fan Squad: A Real-Time Football Companion on AWS Serverless
latest.description: Fan Squad was developed as part of the AWS World Sports Innovation Cup 2026, where our team set out to answer a simple question: How can we transform passive football viewing into a real-time, community-driven experience? By leveraging AWS serverless technologies, we built a platform that allows fans to chat, compete, earn rewards, and experience matches together regardless of location.

latest.title: Enterprise Agent Registry: The Control Plane for Governed AI at Scale
latest.description: The Agent Registry serves as the enterprise-wide system of record for AI agents, tools, skills, MCP servers, workflows, and agent capabilities. It provides a centralized discovery, governance, lifecycle management, and compliance framework that enables organizations to scale from dozens to thousands of AI agents while maintaining security, visibility, operational control, and architectural consistency.

trending.title: System Design for Beginners: tips from an ex Amazon Software Engineer
trending.description: System Design felt overwhelming when I started at Amazon. There were too many terms, too much to learn, no clear starting point. After years of building large-scale systems, I now know better what actually matters to design a well rounded system: how to define requirements, build technical foundations, master trade-offs, and prepare for system design interviews. In this article, I will walk you through what I struggled with so you don't have to, and give you a path to improve your System Design skills.

trending.title: Self-Improving AI Agents: Turn Repeated Reasoning Into Tools the Agent Writes Itself
trending.description: A static AI agent re-reasons the same kind of task from scratch every time, burning tokens and sometimes getting it wrong differently on each run. A self-improving agent solves it once, writes a small verified tool, and reuses that tool exactly from then on. The catch worth knowing up front: writing the tool costs more tokens than one-off reasoning. The payoff is correctness and reuse, not a smaller bill

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.
